integrity: Every defining equation is reconstructed from the multiplication table. The characteristic-two count uses an intrinsic count of singular selfadjoint maps by kernel lines, and a standalone checker replays the symbolic equations and finite-field counts.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the two-dimensional pre-Lie algebra of Wang-Bai-Liu-Sheng Example 6.3.
It counts fixed-coordinate structures and does not take an automorphism quotient.
The zeta statements are rational-point counts of the structure parameter spaces.
title: A characteristic-\(2\) jump in pseudo-Hessian–Nijenhuis structures
